verification_levels.ABSTRACT_PAGE_READ: Da mo trang cong bo chinh thuc (arXiv abs / ACL Anthology / NeurIPS proceedings / trang nha cung cap) va doc tom tat. Du de trich metadata va de dien nhung o ma tran ma TOM TAT noi ro.
verification_levels.REPO_PREVERIFIED: Da xac minh trong wave truoc va ghi o docs/THESIS_REFERENCES.md; muc do xac minh giu nguyen theo file do.
verification_levels.LISTING_ONLY: Chi xac minh o trang liet ke (tieu de, tac gia, noi cong bo).

quy_tac: Khong o nao trong LITERATURE_COMPARISON_MATRIX duoc ghi 'No' chi vi tom tat khong nhac toi. Truong hop do ghi NR (not reported) hoac UNCLEAR.

sources.title: MagicGeo: Training-Free Text-Guided Geometric Diagram Generation
sources.included_reason: He sinh hinh hoc tu van ban co giai bang solver hinh thuc — doi chung gan nhat ve NHIEM VU sinh hinh, nhung la hinh hoc PHANG va dau ra la hinh tinh.

sources.title: GeoLoom: High-quality Geometric Diagram Generation from Textual Input
sources.included_reason: Co ngon ngu hinh thuc rieng (GeoLingua) ma hoa phu thuoc dung hinh — truc so sanh IR gan AlgoSim nhat trong nhom sinh hinh 2D. Toa do giai bang toi uu Monte Carlo (xap xi so), khac han so hoc chinh xac.

sources.title: GeoBuildBench: A Benchmark for Interactive and Executable Geometry Construction from Natural Language
sources.included_reason: CONG TRINH DAT DUNG BAI TOAN cua AlgoSim ra thanh mot benchmark: de tu nhien -> chuong trinh DSL -> hinh thoa rang buoc kiem duoc. La ly do phai phat bieu khoang trong HEP hon: y tuong 'dung hinh thuc thi duoc tu de tu nhien' KHONG con moi. Khac biet: hinh hoc PHANG, 489 de tieng Trung, la BENCHMARK chu khong phai he phuc vu nguoi hoc.

sources.title: Draw2Think: Harnessing Geometry Reasoning through Constraint Engine Interaction
sources.included_reason: DOI CHUNG MANH NHAT. Tom tat khai phu CA hinh hoc phang VA hinh hoc khong gian, dung vong Propose-Draw-Verify tren constraint engine cua GeoGebra, va bao 95,9% predicate-level / 84,0% problem-level construction validation. Day la cong trinh lam yeu nhat moi tuyen bo 'chua ai dung hinh 3D tu de bai'.

sources.title: Bridging Formal Language with Chain-of-Thought Reasoning to Geometry Problem Solving
sources.venue: arXiv preprint (arXiv:2508.09099, nop 12/08/2025). Mo hinh trong bai ten la GF-Reasoner.
sources.included_reason: Chuong trinh hinh thuc chay duoc bang solver, co phan hoi kiem chung vao vong hoc (solver-in-the-loop RL). Muc tieu la DAP SO, khong phai mo phong.

sources.title: Towards Generating Controllable and Solvable Geometry Problem by Leveraging Symbolic Deduction Engine
sources.venue: Proceedings of the 63rd Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics (Volume 6: Industry Track), pages 1378-1398
sources.included_reason: Sinh DE va hinh kem bang symbolic deduction engine + bo loc — huong nguoc voi AlgoSim (sinh de, khong phai phuc vu de co san), nhung cung mot ho ky thuat 'engine ky hieu chan loi cua LLM'.

sources.title: Verifiable Geometry Problem Solving: Solver-Driven Autoformalization and Theorem Proposing
sources.venue: arXiv preprint (arXiv:2606.27926, nop 26/06/2026). He trong bai ten la SD-GPS.
sources.included_reason: Dung solver lam 'execution oracle' xuyen suot — gan voi luan diem 'chi phuc vu thu kiem chung duoc' cua AlgoSim, nhung ket qua la LOI GIAI/dinh ly, khong phai mo phong.

sources.title: VeriGeo: Controllable Geometry Question Generation with Numerical and Analytical Verification
sources.included_reason: DOI THU MANH NHAT tren truc SO HOC CHINH XAC va tren truc TU CHOI: pipeline ba chang kiem numerical consistency / analytical realizability / global consistency roi 'repair or reject'. Phai neu ten khi noi ve dong gop C1.

sources.title: SolidGeo: Measuring Multimodal Spatial Math Reasoning in Solid Geometry
sources.included_reason: Benchmark hinh hoc KHONG GIAN quy mo lon (3.113 bai K-12 va thi). Chung minh mien 3D dang duoc quan tam — nhung o dang TRA LOI, khong dung hinh.

sources.title: DynaSolidGeo: A Dynamic Benchmark for Genuine Spatial Mathematical Reasoning of VLMs in Solid Geometry
sources.included_reason: Benchmark 3D dong, 503 cau goc sinh nhieu bien the; ket luan mo hinh sut manh o tac vu doi tri tue khong gian cao. Cung co lap luan 'mien 3D kho' cua khoa luan.

sources.title: Geoparsing: Diagram Parsing for Plane and Solid Geometry with a Unified Formal Language
sources.venue: Accepted to ACL 2026 (ban tien an ban arXiv:2604.11600, nop 13/04/2026, v2 16/04/2026)
sources.included_reason: Cong trinh DUY NHAT trong tap khao sat co ngon ngu hinh thuc HOP NHAT cho ca hinh phang va hinh KHONG GIAN. Nhung huong di NGUOC: hinh -> ngon ngu hinh thuc (parsing). AlgoSim di chieu de -> chuong trinh -> hinh. Day la cach phat bieu khoang trong chinh xac nhat.

sources.title: AutoGPS: Automated Geometry Problem Solving via Multimodal Formalization and Deductive Reasoning
sources.included_reason: Neuro-symbolic, hinh thuc hoa da phuong thuc roi suy dien; 99% stepwise logical coherence. Doi chung cho truc 'suy dien ky hieu kiem duoc'.

sources.title: GGBench: A Geometric Generative Reasoning Benchmark for Unified Multimodal Models
sources.included_reason: Benchmark do 'generative reasoning' voi dung hinh lam testbed — xac nhan huong 'dung hinh la phep do nang luc' dang thanh hinh trong tai lieu.

sources.title: A Survey of Deep Learning for Geometry Problem Solving
sources.venue: Proceedings of the 64th Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics (Volume 1: Long Papers), pages 39416-39448, San Diego, California, United States
sources.included_reason: Khao sat binh duyet moi nhat cua chinh linh vuc — dung lam NEO cho scoping review va lam bang chung rang tap tac vu GPS da duoc he thong hoa. Tom tat KHONG tach rieng hinh hoc 3D hay sinh hinh, nen khong duoc trich no de noi ho ve khoang trong 3D.

sources.title: Text2CAD: Generating Sequential CAD Designs from Beginner-to-Expert Level Text Prompts
sources.venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 37 (NeurIPS 2024), Main Conference Track
sources.included_reason: DOI CHUNG RANH GIOI cho text-to-3D co tham so: van ban -> mo hinh CAD tham so tuan tu. Danh gia bang do do thi giac/tham so/hinh hoc, KHONG bang kiem chung hinh thuc, va khong phuc vu giao duc hinh hoc.

sources.title: Solving olympiad geometry without human demonstrations
sources.included_reason: AlphaGeometry — moc dinh vi cho suy luan hinh hoc tu dong. Hinh hoc PHANG, dau ra la CHUNG MINH.

sources.title: PAL: Program-aided Language Models
sources.venue: Proceedings of the 40th International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2023), PMLR 202, 10764-10799
sources.included_reason: Nguyen tac 'mo hinh sinh chuong trinh, runtime tat dinh giai' — to tien truc tiep cua kien truc AlgoSim. Chuong trinh la Python DA DUNG, khong co rang buoc kieu chan mo hinh phat ket qua.

sources.title: GSM-Symbolic: Understanding the Limitations of Mathematical Reasoning in Large Language Models
sources.venue: International Conference on Learning Representations (ICLR 2025); tien an ban arXiv:2410.05229
sources.included_reason: Bang chung LLM dao dong khi doi gia tri so va sut toi 65% khi them mot menh de thua — co so thuc nghiem cho ranh gioi R0.

sources.title: Let Me Speak Freely? A Study on the Impact of Format Restrictions on Performance of Large Language Models
sources.included_reason: Rang buoc dinh dang lam giam nang luc suy luan — chi phi cua viec ep mo hinh viet IR co kieu. Phai neu khi bien minh thiet ke lugc do.

sources.title: Adaptive Precision Floating-Point Arithmetic and Fast Robust Geometric Predicates
sources.included_reason: Nen tang cho luan diem 'vi ngu hinh hoc tren float co the sai/khong nhat quan' — co so cua quyet dinh dung so hoc chinh xac.

sources.title: A meta-analysis of Geogebra software decade of assisted mathematics learning: what to learn and where to go?
sources.included_reason: Nghien cuu giao duc 3D/DGS thu nhat: hieu qua cua phan mem hinh hoc dong, 29 nghien cuu / 2.111 hoc sinh. Gioi han: chi Indonesia 2010-2020.

sources.title: Enhancing mathematical education with spatial visualization tools
sources.included_reason: Nghien cuu giao duc 3D thu hai: cong cu truc quan hoa khong gian ho tro dung cho nguoi hoc thieu hut. Gioi han: mau la SINH VIEN ky thuat.

sources.title: Neurosymbolic AI and its Taxonomy: a survey
sources.included_reason: CONTEXT_ONLY — chi de noi 'ghep no-ron voi ky hieu la mot huong co ten va co khao sat'. KHONG duoc dung de gan AlgoSim vao mot o taxonomy.

sources.title: GeoGebra Math Apps (3D Calculator, Geometry, Calculator Suite, Math Solver)
sources.venue: Trang tai ve chinh thuc geogebra.org
sources.included_reason: Doi chung bat buoc. Mo ta chinh thuc: 3D Calculator = 'Graph functions and perform calculations in 3D'; Geometry = 'Explore geometric concepts and constructions in a dynamic environment'; Math Solver = 'Take a photo of your math homework. Get step-by-step solutions with explanations'. KHONG mo ta nao noi den dau vao la de bai bang van ban tu nhien sinh ra dung hinh 3D.

sources.title: Introducing Desmos Studio's 3D Calculator (Beta)
sources.included_reason: Doi chung bat buoc. Da doc: la MAY TINH DO THI dua tren bieu thuc/phuong trinh, khong phai cong cu dung hinh tong hop, va khong nhan de bai bang van ban.

sources.title: Cabri 3D — the interactive spatial geometry and mathematics software
sources.venue: Trang san pham chinh thuc cabri.com
sources.included_reason: Cong cu hinh hoc dong 3D thu ba theo yeu cau muc 6. Da doc trang chinh thuc: KHONG co bat ky mo ta nao ve dung hinh tu dong tu de bai bang ngon ngu tu nhien.
